notes.title: VR Support in "Uploaded"
notes.content: I have begun to work on a VR mode for Uploaded, as I believe that the game fits well for VR. There is no guaranteed that it may ever be released, but if it does, I don't have a plan for how long it may take. The chances are that it will be completed, and will be so sometime within this year as most of the systems in the game allow for easy integration of VR. So, hope for the best!

notes.title: Sliding, Healing, and Jumping Update
notes.content:
Sorry I haven't been including a change list, here is the first one:

Additions:
*Added continuous sliding (while in the air)
*Added new bullet tracer effect
*New falling animations
*Sound effects while sliding
*Particle effect while sliding
*Added healing
*Added crouch jumping
*Added radial impulse to the rocket launcher rockets
*Added damage counter next to damaged player (can be disabled via settings)
*Added bullet holes to all flesh materials (players, monsters, etc)
*Added decal optimization setting
*Added blood drops to blood splatter
*Added new shield effect for newly spaned players
*Added display tab for the settings menu
*Added gameplay tab for the settings menu

Adjustments:
*New sliding animations
*Adjusted physical animation for monsters' death
*Improved bot AI

Fixes:
*Fixed bots punching/mele with teammates
*Fixed feet clipping in the ground when running
*Player can no longer see own head when extreme camera shake occurs
*Fixed only one kill-feed message showing up at a time
*Fixed bots spawning without AI

Removed:
*Head is no longer removed when a player is hit with a headshot

Misc:
*Networking improvements
*Networking optimizations
*Performance improvements with mesh LODs

notes.title: A game update! Added in ADS, improved wall-running system, smarter AI, bug fixes
notes.content: Because of school starting up, development for the game has slowed down a lot. I am putting school as my main priority, and only working on the game in my free time. But after about a month, I bring you a new update! In this update, I added in ADS, an improved wall-running system, smarter AI, a new reloading system, and major bug fixes! I also added in a cool little easter egg... ; )

notes.title: Updates to Uploaded coming soon!
notes.content: Updates to Uploaded should be coming soon! Development has slowed down a little bit due to school, and I've really only been able to work on the game on the weekends, but more updates should be coming soon!

notes.title: Bug fixes and Password Secured Servers
notes.content: Fixed various bugs and added the ability to secure a server with a password

notes.title: New "Parkour Race" Game mode
notes.content: In the new Parkour Race game mode, you and a set number of players will race through a randomly generated parkour course and avoid deadly obstacles while trying not to fall off and die. Each player spawns with an automatic pistol but other weapons will be randomly spawned throughout the level. Whoever makes it to the finish line first wins the match!

notes.title: New tutorial, reworked parkour mechanics, parkour practice level, and much more
notes.content: The new tutorial is a linear style tutorial with informational text that appears at the bottom of the screen. The wall-running mechanics have been reworked to be easier to use and feel smoother. For the time trial level in the single-player component, I raised the walls to allow for easier wall-running and fixed the bug where loot boxes spawn in the walls. The parkour level gives you the chance to practice all of the mechanics while giving you access to all of the weapons and the opportunity to practice your aim by shooting at monsters. The bug fixes are mostly minor, while there are a few major. For the new menu screen, you'll have to load in to see it for yourself, its nothing too exciting.

notes.title: New Weapon: Sniper Rifle
notes.content: The sniper rifle is a high damage and high accuracy weapon that is now available
